description: Runs the AI analysis over every answer so far and returns an executive summary with themes, sentiment and quotes; the report is then also part of get_campaign_results. Re-running with no new answers returns the same report. A sandbox campaign gets the illustrative sample report, marked sample: true.

apiKey.description: Your Clearvoyance API key (cv_live_… or cv_test_…), from create_account

campaignId.description: A campaign id from launch_campaign or list_my_campaigns

name: analyze_campaign
title: Analyse the answers
